recognize_zh: 視野中央是一顆遠大於周圍顆粒球的巨大細胞，核呈多葉相連、染色質粗，胞質大量且充滿細小嗜天青顆粒；這是成熟巨核細胞（mature megakaryocyte）的標準樣貌，周圍是正常成熟的顆粒球系。
features: Very large cell, many times the diameter of adjacent neutrophils
Multilobated, connected nuclear lobes with coarse, condensed chromatin
Abundant pale lilac cytoplasm filled with fine azurophilic granules (granular/platelet-producing stage)
Surrounding granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands) with normal granulation
Occasional erythroid precursors in a background of proteinaceous material
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mature megakaryocyte with a large multilobated nucleus composed of connected lobes with coarse chromatin and abundant finely granular cytoplasm, corresponding to the granular platelet-producing stage. The surrounding cells show orderly granulocytic maturation with normal granulation and scattered erythroid precursors. No dysplastic megakaryocytic features, such as separated lobes or hypolobation, are seen. Findings represent a normal mature megakaryocyte.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts contain multiple separate, uniform round nuclei rather than a single lobulated nucleus with connected lobes.

ddx.dx: Dysplastic megakaryocyte with separated nuclear lobes
ddx.vs: Dysplastic forms show widely separated, round nuclear lobes or hypolobation, unlike the connected lobulated nucleus seen here.
MPN megakaryocytes are enlarged, hyperlobated or bulbous and cluster together on biopsy, whereas this single megakaryocyte has normal lobation.
